text: The Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian award, was instituted in:
textHi: भारत रत्न, भारत का सर्वोच्च नागरिक सम्मान, किस वर्ष स्थापित हुआ?

options.whyIncorrect: The Republic was formed in 1950; the award came four years later.
No civilian awards existed at Independence.
1969 is the year the Dadasaheb Phalke Award began.

explanation: Bharat Ratna and the Padma awards (Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, Padma Shri) were instituted on 2 January 1954. First recipients (1954): C. Rajagopalachari, S. Radhakrishnan, C.V. Raman. The Bharat Ratna medal is peepal-leaf shaped.
source: Ministry of Home Affairs — Padma Awards portal
examRelevance: National awards are listed in the official syllabus.

text: India's highest sporting honour, renamed in 2021, is now called the:
textHi: भारत का सर्वोच्च खेल सम्मान, जिसका 2021 में नाम बदला गया, अब क्या कहलाता है?

options.whyIncorrect: Arjuna Award is for outstanding performance, ranked below the top honour.

options.text: Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award

options.whyIncorrect: This was the OLD name until August 2021.

explanation: In August 2021 the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna was renamed the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award after the hockey legend (whose birthday, 29 August, is National Sports Day). Other awards: Arjuna (athletes), Dronacharya (coaches), Dhyan Chand Award (lifetime), Maulana Abul Kalam Azad Trophy (universities).
source: Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports — National Sports Awards scheme

text: The 'Kumbh Mela' at Prayagraj is held at the confluence (Sangam) of which rivers?
textHi: प्रयागराज में कुंभ मेला किन नदियों के संगम पर आयोजित होता है?

options.whyIncorrect: Gomti joins the Ganga near Ghazipur/Saidpur, not at Prayagraj.

options.text: Ganga, Yamuna and the mythical Saraswati

options.whyIncorrect: Ghaghara joins the Ganga in Bihar (Chhapra).

explanation: Triveni Sangam at Prayagraj. Kumbh Mela is inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List of Intangible Cultural Heritage (2017). Kumbh sites: Prayagraj, Haridwar, Ujjain, Nashik. Maha Kumbh 2025 was held at Prayagraj.

Premchand (Dhanpat Rai Srivastava, 1880–1936), born at Lamhi near Varanasi, UP — 'Upanyas Samrat'. Works: Godan, Gaban, Nirmala, Sevasadan, Rangbhoomi, Karmabhoomi; stories: Idgah, Kafan, Poos ki Raat, Namak ka Daroga.
examRelevance: 'रचनाएँ' (works) is explicitly in the syllabus; Premchand is a UP icon.

text: The Nobel Prize in Literature (1913), the first for an Asian, was awarded to:
textHi: साहित्य का नोबेल पुरस्कार (1913), जो किसी एशियाई को पहला था, किसे मिला?

options.whyIncorrect: Raman won the Physics Nobel in 1930.

explanation: Tagore won for 'Gitanjali'. Indian Nobel laureates: Tagore (Lit 1913), Raman (Phys 1930), Mother Teresa (Peace 1979), Amartya Sen (Econ 1998), Kailash Satyarthi (Peace 2014); Indian-origin: Har Gobind Khorana, S. Chandrasekhar, V. Ramakrishnan, Abhijit Banerjee.

text: The 'One District One Product' (ODOP) scheme, later adopted nationally, was launched in Uttar Pradesh in:
textHi: 'एक जनपद एक उत्पाद' (ODOP) योजना, जिसे बाद में राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर अपनाया गया, उत्तर प्रदेश में कब शुरू हुई?

options.whyIncorrect: 2020 is when the national PMFME scheme adopted an ODOP approach.

explanation: ODOP was launched by the UP government on 24 January 2018 (UP Diwas) to promote district-specific traditional products (e.g., Bhadohi carpets, Moradabad brassware, Firozabad glass, Lucknow chikankari, Varanasi silk, Agra leather). The concept was later scaled nationally.
examRelevance: UP flagship scheme — highly likely under 'प्रदेश से सम्बन्धित'.

text: Uttar Pradesh Diwas (UP Day) is celebrated on:
textHi: उत्तर प्रदेश दिवस कब मनाया जाता है?

options.whyIncorrect: 1 November is the foundation day of several other states (Karnataka, Kerala, MP, Chhattisgarh, Haryana, Punjab).

explanation: The 'United Provinces' were renamed 'Uttar Pradesh' on 24 January 1950; UP Diwas has been celebrated on 24 January since 2018. Capital: Lucknow; High Court: Prayagraj (Allahabad) with Lucknow bench; 75 districts, 18 divisions.

text: Which of the following is NOT a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Uttar Pradesh?
textHi: निम्न में से कौन उत्तर प्रदेश में यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर स्थल नहीं है?
explanation: UP has three cultural World Heritage Sites — Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, Fatehpur Sikri. Sarnath (Varanasi), site of Buddha's first sermon (Dhammachakkappavattana) and origin of the national emblem's Lion Capital, is on India's tentative list, not yet inscribed (as of the app's content date — verify latest UNESCO decisions).
examRelevance: Heritage sites in UP — likely question.

text: The Olympic Games 2028 will be hosted by:
textHi: ओलंपिक खेल 2028 की मेजबानी कौन करेगा?
explanation: Summer Olympics: 2020 Tokyo (held 2021), 2024 Paris, 2028 Los Angeles, 2032 Brisbane. Winter Olympics 2026: Milan–Cortina d'Ampezzo, Italy. India has expressed interest in bidding for 2036.

text: 'Nautanki' is a traditional folk theatre form primarily associated with:
textHi: 'नौटंकी' मुख्यतः किस राज्य की पारंपरिक लोक-नाट्य विधा है?
explanation: Nautanki (Hathras and Kanpur styles) is a musical folk theatre of UP. Other folk forms: Tamasha (Maharashtra), Bhavai (Gujarat), Jatra (Bengal), Yakshagana (Karnataka), Swang (Haryana), Maach (MP), Ramlila/Raslila (UP).
examRelevance: Indian art & culture with UP linkage.

text: The 'Statue of Unity', the world's tallest statue, is dedicated to:
textHi: 'स्टैच्यू ऑफ यूनिटी', विश्व की सबसे ऊँची प्रतिमा, किसे समर्पित है?

options.whyIncorrect: No; Gandhi statues exist but not this one.
The 'Statue of Equality' proposals relate to Ambedkar.
Bose's statue is at India Gate canopy, New Delhi (2022).

explanation: 182 m tall, at Kevadia (Ekta Nagar), Narmada district, Gujarat; inaugurated 31 October 2018 (Patel's birth anniversary — National Unity Day/Rashtriya Ekta Diwas). Sculptor: Ram V. Sutar.

text: The 'PM SHRI Schools' scheme, approved in 2022, aims to:
textHi: 2022 में स्वीकृत 'पीएम श्री स्कूल' योजना का उद्देश्य है:

options.text: Provide free laptops to all students
Upgrade 14,500+ existing schools as exemplar NEP-2020 schools
Set up new private schools in every district
options.whyIncorrect: PM SHRI strengthens existing government/KVS/NVS schools.

explanation: PM SHRI (PM Schools for Rising India) — Cabinet approval 7 Sept 2022 — develops over 14,500 schools (including Kendriya Vidyalayas and Navodaya Vidyalayas) as model schools showcasing NEP 2020: green schools, ICT, experiential and competency-based learning.
examRelevance: Education scheme — relevant to both exams and the KVS interview.

text: 'PM POSHAN' scheme is the renamed version of:
textHi: 'पीएम पोषण' योजना किसका नया नाम है?

options.whyIncorrect: ICDS (1975) is now part of Saksham Anganwadi & Poshan 2.0.

explanation: In September 2021, the Mid-Day Meal Scheme (national launch 1995) was renamed PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman), extended to Balvatika (pre-primary) children in government schools along with Classes 1–8.
examRelevance: Education schemes are an easy score in GK.

text: The headquarters of UNESCO is located in:
textHi: यूनेस्को का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?

options.whyIncorrect: Geneva hosts WHO, ILO, WTO, UNHCR.
New York hosts the UN headquarters and UNICEF.

explanation: UNESCO (est. 1945) — Paris. Key HQs: UN — New York; WHO/ILO/WTO — Geneva; IAEA — Vienna; FAO — Rome; IMF/World Bank — Washington DC; UNEP — Nairobi; ICJ — The Hague.

text: Hindi Diwas is celebrated on 14 September because on this day in 1949:
textHi: हिंदी दिवस 14 सितंबर को क्यों मनाया जाता है?

options.text: Hindi was declared the national language
options.whyIncorrect: India has no 'national language'; Hindi is an OFFICIAL language of the Union.

options.text: The Constituent Assembly adopted Hindi in Devanagari script as the official language of the Union
The Official Languages Act was passed
options.whyIncorrect: The Official Languages Act was passed in 1963.

explanation: Article 343: Hindi in Devanagari is the official language of the Union (adopted 14 Sept 1949). Eighth Schedule lists 22 languages. World Hindi Day is 10 January. The 2026 Hindi Diwas marked the 77th anniversary.
source: Constitution of India, Art. 343; Dept. of Official Language
examRelevance: Important days + constitution — a tricky, frequently mis-answered item.

text: The Lion Capital of Ashoka, adopted as India's national emblem, was found at:
textHi: अशोक का सिंह स्तंभ शीर्ष, जिसे भारत के राष्ट्रीय प्रतीक के रूप में अपनाया गया, कहाँ मिला?

options.whyIncorrect: Sanchi (MP) has the Great Stupa; its capital differs.

explanation: The Lion Capital (c. 250 BCE) from Sarnath, Varanasi (UP), was adopted as the State Emblem on 26 January 1950, with 'Satyameva Jayate' from the Mundaka Upanishad. It is kept in the Sarnath Museum.
source: State Emblem of India (Prohibition of Improper Use) Act 2005; ASI
examRelevance: National symbols + UP site — high yield.
